name: trace-timeline
title: TraceTimeline
description: A long session on one clock, drawn on a canvas at most one thing per device pixel: a strip with a ruler, diamonds, density with marks over it, thread activity fetched for the view, requests and several lanes, or the same timeline as a rail for narrow windows with stops as dashes that swell around the pointer, a scrub that slows as you pull away, and pinch and wheel zoom. A slider, with the keyboard that implies.
